name: Data center replication / Define consistency and failure assumptions

intent.outcome: Design replication between data centers without relying entirely on a database’s built-in replication.
intent.users: Callers, state owners and operators named by the problem.
intent.constraints: Make ordering, durability, capacity and retry assumptions explicit. Authored replication protocol built on fixed leader/follower nodes and actual network messages; does not rely on the opaque quorum-db kernel. Per-key sequence versions, bounded retained outbox and duplicate suppression execute; one designated writer avoids conflicts by construction. No consensus, automatic failover, durable physical WAL, active-active merge, cross-key transaction or real data-center capacity is proven. Crash recovery preserves simulated state; it is not a disk durability experiment. These are Stage 1 simulations; deployment and operation remain design obligations.
intent.success: An observable request path, bounded waiting, visible failures and a justified recovery policy.
